PainterlyNPR__ShadowLines__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: The illustrator's marker accent on a window - a shade line: a straight, slightly darker stroke on the glass beside each jamb and glazing bar, on the side away from the sun.

ShadowLinesNotes.BarDepth: How far a glazing bar stands off the glass: the depth that casts its shadow
ShadowLinesNotes.BarHalfWidth: Half a 25 mm bar: the stroke starts at its shaded edge
ShadowLinesNotes.MinMm: Never thinner than a marker's nib on the sheet
ShadowLinesNotes.MaxShare: Never wider than this share of the pane it lies on
ShadowLinesNotes.Bar: Density beside a glazing bar, at 100%
